target: Linux x86-64 System V ABI; current checked-out MIR headers and archive

execution_paths: MIR JIT through exact C prototypes

additional_calls: nested internal call with caller-live values
two-result MIR call via a single-result caller
arithmetic: small bounded values; weighted checksums avoid integer overflow; floating values are exact binary fractions and compared exactly
scope_exclusions: variadic calls deferred pending target/API contract review
JMP/JRET nonstandard ABI not treated as ordinary C call
no mismatched C prototypes are invoked
no cross-target execution in the initial campaign

performance_preregistration.suspicion_threshold: Investigate a backend route only if its median per-call route exceeds 2x the same function's JIT repeated-call median; do not infer from one sample.
